_meta.purpose: What is actually possible from where the student is standing, with what it asks and when it happens. Play narrated what happened; this names what could. Every entry is a real Singapore route, mechanism or allowance, written so a fourteen year old can act on it.
rules: State the requirement as a fact about the route, never as a distance the student falls short by.
Never imply a route is closed. Requirements are timetables, not verdicts.
No aggregate is invented. Where a figure is provisional the truth line says so.
_meta.sources: Figures match DESIGN.md's confirmed table for the 2027 SEC cohort.

forkNeeds.d_alevels: L1R4 of sixteen or better across five G3 subjects, with English at C6, G3 Maths at D7 and Mother Tongue at D7.
forkNeeds.d_polyroad: Four G3 subjects and one G2 subject in the B slot. ELR2B2 of twenty two or better, and twenty four for nursing.
forkNeeds.d_iteroad: A pass that carries you in. Higher Nitec runs three years, and Nitec is the award you hold if you exit early.
forkNeeds.d_portfolio: A portfolio or an audition, and the year of practice sitting behind it.
forkNeeds.d_fifth: The Sec 5 criteria. A fifth year taken at all G3 asks a gross ELMAB3 of nineteen or better.
forkNeeds.d_mi: L1R4 of twenty or better across five G3 subjects. Wider at the door than a junior college, and a year longer.
forkNeeds.d_pfp: ELMAB3 of twelve or better at G2. You pick a cluster rather than a single course.

possibilities.label: Move a subject up a level
possibilities.needs: A teacher who thinks you can carry it, and one term of showing you can
possibilities.leads: A wider set of courses open to you at the end of Sec 4
possibilities.truth: Under Full Subject Based Banding your level is decided each year. It is not a label you were given once.

possibilities.label: Apply through Early Admissions
possibilities.needs: A course you can argue for, and something you have actually made or done
possibilities.leads: A conditional offer before results, held if you meet the course requirement
possibilities.truth: EAE weighs aptitude and interest. The offer still asks you to meet the course minimum, so the exam still counts.

possibilities.label: Start the folder now
possibilities.when: This term, not the term you need it
possibilities.needs: One finished thing a month, kept somewhere you can find it again
possibilities.leads: Something to show at an interview, an audition, or an EAE round
possibilities.truth: A folder is easier to fill over three years than over three weeks.

possibilities.label: Ask a teacher what they see
possibilities.needs: One question, and the nerve to sit through the whole answer
possibilities.leads: A clearer view of what you carry that you cannot get from inside
possibilities.truth: Teachers hold a picture of you built from three years of watching. Most will hand it over if asked.

possibilities.label: Take a fifth year
possibilities.needs: The Sec 5 criteria met, and a reason that belongs to you
possibilities.leads: A second sitting, then polytechnic, Millennia Institute or junior college
possibilities.truth: A fifth year is a year. Some roads only open after it, and the year is not held against you afterwards.

possibilities.label: Millennia Institute
possibilities.needs: L1R4 of twenty or better across five G3 subjects
possibilities.leads: The same A Level, taken over three years instead of two
possibilities.truth: MI is deliberately wider at the door and slower inside. The certificate at the end is the same one.

possibilities.label: The Poly Foundation Programme
possibilities.needs: ELMAB3 of twelve or better, and a cluster you would be glad to be in
possibilities.leads: One foundation year, then straight into the first year of a diploma
possibilities.truth: PFP admits you to a cluster rather than a course. From AY2028 it is open to any mix of subject levels.

possibilities.label: Start Higher Nitec at year two
possibilities.when: Applying after Sec 4, to the 2027 intake
possibilities.needs: ELMAB3 of nineteen or better
possibilities.leads: Higher Nitec without sitting through the first year
possibilities.truth: This route replaced the old DPP. The last DPP intake is 2027, so the mechanism has changed name and shape.

possibilities.label: Nursing at a polytechnic
possibilities.needs: ELR2B2 of twenty four or better
possibilities.leads: A nursing diploma, then practice, or a degree later
possibilities.truth: Nursing carries a wider net score than most diplomas because the need is real and the training is long.

possibilities.label: An arts school, on a portfolio
possibilities.when: Audition and portfolio rounds, from Sec 4
possibilities.needs: Work you made, ready to show, and one honest person to look at it first
possibilities.leads: A diploma at an arts institution, entered on what you can do
possibilities.truth: A portfolio is read as evidence of practice rather than proof of talent. It rewards the student who started early.

possibilities.label: Appeal a posting
possibilities.needs: A course you can name, and a reason that is more than wanting it
possibilities.leads: A second look at where you were posted
possibilities.truth: Appealing is an ordinary part of the exercise. Ask early, ask in person, and ask about the next intake too.

possibilities.label: Order your choices carefully
possibilities.needs: Your list ordered by what you actually want, not by what you think you can get
possibilities.leads: A posting decided by your order when scores tie
possibilities.truth: From 2028 one portal handles this. Where two students tie, the order you listed decides, so put the real first choice first.

possibilities.label: Switch course inside the school
possibilities.when: Usually the end of the first year
possibilities.needs: Your first year grades, a place free in the other course, and a reason
possibilities.leads: The diploma you actually meant to take
possibilities.truth: Transfers happen every year. Ask the school what the window is long before you need to use it.

possibilities.label: The polytechnic to degree road
possibilities.needs: A GPA the university you want will look at, and modules that match the degree
possibilities.leads: A degree place, sometimes with a year of credit already granted
possibilities.truth: Polytechnic graduates enter local universities every year. Some enter with exemptions that shorten the degree.

possibilities.label: The ITE to polytechnic road
possibilities.when: The final year of Higher Nitec
possibilities.needs: A net GPA of two point five to apply, three point five raw to be guaranteed
possibilities.leads: A polytechnic diploma
possibilities.truth: The guarantee is written down, so it is not a favour anyone grants you. CCA points lift the net figure, never the raw one.

possibilities.label: Take the Nitec and start working
possibilities.when: At the exit point inside the three years
possibilities.needs: A trade you can practise, and a first employer willing to teach you
possibilities.leads: Work now, with Higher Nitec still open to you later
possibilities.truth: Nitec is the award you exit with from the three year Higher Nitec course. Leaving is a decision, and it reverses.

possibilities.label: Turn the attachment into an offer
possibilities.needs: Turning up early, asking for the harder task, and saying out loud that you want the job
possibilities.leads: A job offer before you have graduated
possibilities.truth: A great many first jobs began as an attachment somebody remembered clearly.

possibilities.label: Go on exchange
possibilities.needs: Grades that clear the bar, and the money planned for in advance
possibilities.leads: A semester somewhere else, and the nerve that comes back with you
possibilities.truth: Bursaries and grants exist for this. Ask the office rather than deciding on your own that it is not for you.

possibilities.label: Go to polytechnic after A Levels
possibilities.needs: A diploma course you want more than you want a degree right now
possibilities.leads: A diploma, often with some modules exempted
possibilities.truth: The road runs in that direction too, and it is used more often than anyone says out loud.

possibilities.label: Apply on aptitude, not only grades
possibilities.needs: A portfolio, an interview or a test, depending on the school
possibilities.leads: A place through an aptitude based route
possibilities.truth: Every local university keeps a share of its places for students admitted on more than an aggregate.

possibilities.label: Ask about money early
possibilities.when: As soon as the fee letter appears
possibilities.needs: Household income papers, and one appointment nobody enjoys making
possibilities.leads: Fees covered in part or in full, and a loan you understand
possibilities.truth: Bursaries, loans and hardship funds are ordinary. Nobody in this system is expected to fund it alone.

possibilities.label: Defer a place for service
possibilities.needs: One form, filed before the deadline on it
possibilities.leads: The place kept for you until you finish serving
possibilities.truth: Deferment is routine and the place waits. Serving is done in the army, the police or the civil defence force.

possibilities.label: A degree part time, while working
possibilities.when: Any year you can carry both
possibilities.needs: A course that runs in the evening, and a manager who knows you are doing it
possibilities.leads: A degree over four or five years, without stopping earning
possibilities.truth: SUSS and SIT build part time degrees around working adults. The classmates are mostly people with jobs.

possibilities.label: Spend the SkillsFuture Credit
possibilities.when: From twenty five, whenever you like
possibilities.needs: A course that teaches something you will actually use
possibilities.leads: A skill, paid for out of the credit rather than your pocket
possibilities.truth: The credit does not expire, which is exactly why most people forget they are holding any.

possibilities.label: The mid career top up
possibilities.when: From the year you turn forty
possibilities.needs: A course on the approved list, and a direction you have thought about
possibilities.leads: Four thousand dollars of training paid for
possibilities.truth: The top up was built for people changing direction, not only for people keeping current in the job they have.

possibilities.label: Take the training allowance
possibilities.when: While studying full time, mid career
possibilities.needs: An eligible full time course, and the paperwork filed
possibilities.leads: An allowance that covers some of what you stop earning
possibilities.truth: Lost income is the real barrier to retraining at forty. The allowance exists because that was obvious to everybody.

possibilities.label: A career conversion programme
possibilities.when: When you want a different industry entirely
possibilities.needs: An employer in the new field willing to take you on and train you
possibilities.leads: Paid training into a job in that industry
possibilities.truth: Conversion programmes hire first and teach after, so the interview matters more than the certificate.

possibilities.label: Enter university as a mature student
possibilities.needs: Work behind you, and a case for yourself you can write down
possibilities.leads: A degree begun late and finished anyway
possibilities.truth: Mature entry routes exist at every local university, and the people using them are not unusual.

possibilities.label: Stack short courses into something
possibilities.when: Over a few years, on purpose
possibilities.needs: Courses that build on each other rather than courses that scatter
possibilities.leads: A recognised qualification, assembled a piece at a time
possibilities.truth: Modular certificates can add up to a full qualification when you plan the order before you start.

possibilities.label: Start the thing small
possibilities.needs: One customer, and one month of trying
possibilities.leads: A side thing that grows, or proof it was never going to
possibilities.truth: Most businesses that lasted began beside a job that was paying the rent the whole time.

possibilities.label: Ask for the work you want
possibilities.when: Before the appraisal, never during it
possibilities.needs: A specific ask, and something finished to point at
possibilities.leads: Different work, or a clear answer you can plan around
possibilities.truth: People who end up with the interesting work have usually asked for it out loud, more than once.

possibilities.label: Be the one who tells someone things
possibilities.when: Once five years sit behind you
possibilities.needs: An hour a month, and the honesty to say what you got wrong
possibilities.leads: A network that answers your messages, and a clearer head
possibilities.truth: Explaining a thing is how most people discover they already knew it.

possibilities.label: Go back to school later
possibilities.needs: A reason you can say out loud, and a timetable your household agrees to
possibilities.leads: The qualification you put down years ago
possibilities.truth: A classroom of forty year olds is an ordinary sight now. It was not always, and that changed on purpose.
